_comment: Single source of truth for what the trucks of the waste transport problem may carry: container sizes, truck types with their loading rules, and the chico attachments. A rule is a maximal allowed load written in the company's notation (eN = empty N m3 container, fN = full N m3 container, '2f6 + 1e2' = two full 6 and one empty 2); anything smaller than a listed load is allowed too. Used by frontend/public/waste_model.js (via frontend/server.js), scripts/waste_rules_to_capacities.py, scripts/waste_capacity_check.py and referenced by the docs. Values a planner may change day to day (company site, fleet size, chicos available, working day, service times) live next door in waste_defaults.json.

materials._comment: materials are sold in a container of a standard size that leaves the company full and stays at the client; for the loading rules it is a full container of that size, and other containers may travel with it

chicos._comment: trailers that attach to a truck type. A chico adds extra_loads beds and each bed takes any allowed load of the truck type, so a truck with a chico carries extra_loads + 1 allowed loads at once, any mix (e.g. multiban: '1f6 + 3e2' plus '6e6' plus '1f12'). How many chicos the company has is set in waste_defaults.json; the solver decides which trucks take one.
